title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：radiation　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 radiation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the observer ① measured the radiation that no assistant in the observatory would have recorded, and he said the measuring was the whole of the night. The ② radiation, meaning the ray itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book; radiation, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of radiation in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ radiation at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Radiation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the observer said the recording is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the radiation was the whole of the matter, meaning the danger and not the ray. The ⑥ radiation, meaning the danger and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; radiation, he said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both ray and a danger. He said the danger is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ radiation had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ radiation of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of recording; radiation, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ radiation I remember is the radiation recorded in the log, which closed in 1992 and is still recorded as the quietest in the observatory. ⑩ Radiation, my mother said in 1994, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all radiation, she said, is a danger that has agreed to look like ray. She said the danger was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 辐射（指观测站里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 辐射（指那种辐射本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：measure the radiation 测定这一种辐射
D. n. 辐射（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 辐射之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的辐射之事）
F. n. 辐射（指观测记录里写到、被记载的那一种）
G. n. 辐射、隐患（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 隐患（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: measured the radiation that no assistant in the observatory would have recorded
The radiation, meaning the ray itself and not the lens
Every sort of radiation in that observatory
the radiation at the far dome
the radiation was the whole of the matter
the radiation had become a line in a log
The radiation of the whole thing

answers.why: measure the radiation 意为“测定这一种辐射”，1985 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯记载的一种辐射做了一遍。
radiation 意为“辐射”，指那种辐射本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。
radiation 意为“辐射”，指观测站里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
radiation 意为“辐射”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
radiation 意为“辐射、隐患”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种隐患就是那件事的全部。
radiation 意为“隐患”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种辐射，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
radiation 意为“辐射”，指观测记录里写到、被记载的那一种，到 1990 年这一种成了观测记录里的一行。
radiation 意为“辐射之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的辐射之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的记载。
radiation 意为“辐射”，我记得的是观测记录里记载过的那一种，1992 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一种。
radiation 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，辐射是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的辐射。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1985 年那位观测员测定了观测站里没有一位助手肯记载的一种辐射，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（measure the radiation）
那种辐射，指的是那种辐射本身而不是小小的镜片，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。（radiation）
那处观测站里每一类辐射旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。（radiation）
最远那座圆顶那种辐射，指的是他们留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（radiation）
叔叔说这种隐患就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那种辐射。（radiation）
